title: Out-of-Distribution Detection on Graphs: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2502.08105v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph learning has advanced prediction and discovery across a wide range of relational data applications. In evolving environments, new categories and changes in attributes or relationships can produce out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs on which models make confident but unreliable predictions. Graph out-of-distribution (GOOD) detection identifies such nodes or graphs to support rejection and further assessment. This paper presents the first systematic survey dedicated to GOOD detection. We clarify the problem settings and organize existing methods into six categories according to their primary OOD discrimination mechanisms. The review examines their technical connections, supervision and reference requirements, and conditions of use, alongside representative datasets, OOD constructions, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics. translated_title: 图上的分布外检测：综述
translated_abstract: 图学习已在众多关系数据应用中推动了预测与发现。在不断演变的环境中，新类别的出现以及属性或关系的变化会产生分布外（OOD）输入，模型会在这些输入上做出看似自信却不可靠的预测。图分布外（GOOD）检测旨在识别此类节点或图，以支持对预测的拒答与进一步评估。本文提出了首个专门针对GOOD检测的系统性综述。我们阐明了问题设定，并根据主要的OOD判别机制将现有方法归纳为六大类别。该综述考察了各类方法之间的技术关联、监督与参考信息需求以及适用条件，同时涵盖了代表性数据集、OOD构造方式、基准测试与评估指标。受控的合成对比实验通过展示代表性方法……加深了对检测设定的理解。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对图分布外（GOOD）检测的系统性综述，将现有方法按其主要OOD判别机制分为六大类别，并系统考察了它们的技术关联、监督需求、数据集、基准与评估指标。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic survey on graph out-of-distribution (GOOD) detection, organizing existing methods into six categories based on their primary OOD discrimination mechanisms and systematically examining their technical connections, supervision requirements, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics.
